summary: Small riverside car park ringed by trees; nearest home 50 m away.
reasons: Open asphalt with bays, sealed way in

best_section.where: Western bays of the car park beside the river path, off Brisbane Street

drivers.seclusion: Trees and river on three sides; nearest house 50 m, sailing club 36 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access road from the north-east; marked bays with room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end park road; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Unsigned car park, no fee mapped; many cars parked in daytime.

flags: Low-lying: 2.6-3.6 m elevation beside the Brisbane River
Mapped gate 21 m away, not on the only access
Max grade 6.4% at the north edge, flat in the bays
sun_shade: Tree shade from the south and east; open to the west over the river.
